name: Surrey Youth Stewardship Squad (SYSS)
what_you_do: Drop-in park work with other teens: pull invasive plants, plant trees and shrubs, clean up litter and improve habitat. Tools and training are provided.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Sign up to track volunteer hours.
duration: Drop-in events (length not stated on the page read)
deadline_text: Drop-in dates: Sep 25, Oct 23 and Nov 14, 2026. More dates go to registered members.
how_to_apply: Drop in. Sign up as a Squad member to hear about more dates and track hours. Groups over 5 email ahead.
notes: Events may be called off in extreme weather. Parks: Serpentine Heights Park (Sep 25, Oct 23) and Godwin Farm Biodiversity Preserve Park (Nov 14).
